summary: Every web page starts with the same skeleton: a doctype, an html element, a head with information about the page, and a body with what people see.
notes: <!DOCTYPE html> tells the browser to use modern HTML rules.
Everything inside <head> is information about the page. Only <body> content shows on screen.
The <link> tag loads style.css, so the CSS file styles this page.
pitfall: Putting visible content like <h1> inside <head> instead of <body> is invalid HTML, and browsers move or ignore it.
